subject: Vendor portal sprint: inventory, SSO & evidence handoff
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@notech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal sprint: inventory, SSO & evidence handoff

Hi Elena —

Following up from our intake call last week. We're kicking a short sprint to get NuTech fully profiled in our vendor portals (Whistic + Vendr) and to finalize the SOC2/SIG bundles so your procurement team can close the legal review. To keep the sprint tight, can we confirm a few items before we schedule the working session?

Quick asks:
- Which portal do you want as the source-of-truth for questionnaire responses (Whistic vs Vendr)?
- Do you have SAML metadata ready for Redwood to test SSO? If so, please attach or paste the entity/mapping.
- Any outstanding non-technical evidence (signed SOC2, architecture diagram) that your security team prefers to upload vs. us linking to?

I've attached an inventory CSV (portal_inventory.csv) with the fields we'll import to Vendr; column names map to our template. If you prefer to keep OneTrust as the master, we can mirror.

Proposed working session: 30 min on Monday 2026-10-12 at 16:00 PT to walk assets and agree on ownership. Please confirm or propose an alternate time.

Thanks — I'll loop Priyom in to own the import and Kimberly will coordinate evidence ownership.

Best,
Michael Grant
Senior Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: portal_inventory.csv (CSV stub - column headers: vendor_name, portal, evidence_owner, saml_ready, notes)

From: Elena Martinez <elena@notech.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
Cc: NuTech Security Team <sec@notech.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal sprint: inventory, SSO & evidence handoff

Thanks Michael —

Quick answers:
- We'd prefer Vendr as the source-of-truth (we can export OneTrust if needed, but Vendr works for procurement).
- SAML metadata attached (saml-metadata.xml) — NuTech uses Azure AD and we'll provide a test account for the SSO smoke test.
- Signed SOC2 and our CAIQ export are in a protected drive; we can either share links or you can host pointers in Vendr. We generally prefer pointer links.

Monday 10/12 at 16:00 PT works for us. I'll invite Matt (procurement) to join for the last 10 minutes.

Elena Martinez
Director, Information Security
NuTech Inc

Attachments: saml-metadata.xml (XML stub), vendor-qna.pdf (high-level QnA - redacted)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 11:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal sprint: inventory, SSO & evidence handoff

Looping in a few operational notes from QA of our Vendr import template:

1) Evidence ownership: please confirm whether NuTech wants us to set "Vendor-owned" links (pointer to their drive) or to upload copies to our evidence bucket. For SOX customers we usually ingest copies; for procurement pointers are fine.

2) SSO test plan: if NuTech can provide a test AD account, Priyom can run the SAML assertion smoke test (idp-initiated + sp-initiated). Priyom — you'll need temporary console access to the Vendr staging org; I'll raise a short-lived privileged access ticket once Michael approves.

3) Inventory gaps: I've highlighted three rows in portal_inventory.csv that need clarifying: evidence_owner fields are empty and one entry lists "Arch-Doc (internal)" which NuTech may want to replace with their architecture PDF pointer.

I've created an evidence tracker in Drive to coordinate uploads and access: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B_example_evidence_tracker (please keep it to the persons on this thread).

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Elena Martinez <elena@notech.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal sprint: inventory, SSO & evidence handoff

Thanks Kim + Elena —

Approvals: please proceed with Vendr as the canonical portal and use pointer links for NuTech-owned docs (SOC2 pointer OK). Kimberly, raise the privileged access ticket for Priyom to the Vendr staging org (TTL: 48 hours) and include the scope: import + SSO smoke test only.

Priyom — please own the import. Use the attached CSV as the source. If you hit any schema issues ping me ASAP.

Meeting confirmed: Mon 2026-10-12 16:00 PT (I'll send the calendar invite).

-Michael

Related: https://calendar.google.com/event?action=TEMPLATE&id=meet-ct-20261010-1600

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Elena Martinez <elena@notech.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal sprint: inventory, SSO & evidence handoff

Update from the import side: I ran a dry import into the Vendr staging workspace this morning. Notes:
- Imported 18 of 21 rows; three failed due to missing evidence_owner and one malformed URL in the architecture pointer.
- Uploaded vendor-qna.pdf wrappers to a read-only evidence bucket and added pointer links to the vendor profile (per NuTech preference).
- Per the SAML metadata (saml-metadata.xml) I configured the new SP entry; waiting for NuTech to provide a single test user (id: nu_test1@notech.com) and to flip the allow-list for our test SP entity ID.

Files I placed in the shared Drive folder: portal_inventory_import_log.csv, vendr_staging_screenshots.zip (screenshots), vendor-qna.pdf.

I'll keep the privileged access ticket scoped to 48 hours. Once NuTech confirms the test user I'll run the smoke test and post results here.

- Priyom
Security Integrations Engineer
Redwood Inference
